stem: The Gulf of Tonkin Resolution increased the power of the executive branch by —

options.label: A
options.text: allowing the president to use military force without a declaration of war by Congress

options.label: B
options.text: authorizing the president to choose the Senate Majority Leader

options.label: C
options.text: allowing the president to introduce bills to Congress

options.label: D
options.text: expanding the president’s right to executive privilege
